info.title: PlotRush account and commerce foundation
info.description: Generated from runtime Zod contracts. Scope: newly implemented account/order routes; gameplay paths remain to be added. Staff editorial routes require protected roles and a fresh MFA cookie. Payment simulation is local-only. Paystack test checkout, verification and signed webhook acknowledgement are implemented; live billing remains gated.
